After,Ⓒprep.Ⓓanu pr. to roots, paScAt; ‘to go a(fter)’ anugam, anusf, 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 (of time) paraM, anaMtaraM, UrDvaM, (with abl.); ‘a(fter) that’ tasmAtparaM, tataUrDvaM; ‘a(fter) one another’ AnupUrvyeRa, anupUrvaSaH. ‘a(fter) 10 years’ daSavarze vyatIte; ‘a(fter) eating’ BojanAnaMtaraM; paScAt (gen.), anu in comp.; ‘a(fter) a few days’ dinezu gacCatsu; by gerund, or pUrvakaM in comp.; anAmayapraSnapUrvakaM (S. 5); ‘he waters tree a(fter) tree’ vfkzaM vfkzaM siMcati; ‘in a(fter) time’ AgAmikAle, uttarakAle.
Ⓑ
 3 anusAreRa-sArataH, anurUpaM; ‘you write a(fter) his hand’ leKane tasyAnukarozi; ‘he is called a(fter) his grandfather’ sa pitAmahanAmnA'BiDIyate-AhUyate; See Name.
ⒷIn comp. e. g. ‘a(fter) ages’, ex. by uttara; ‘a(fter)-ages’ uttarakAlaH; putrapOtrAH; ‘a(fter) all’ aMte, Seze; ‘a(fter) birth’, s. jarAyu n. ‘a(fter)-crop’ Sasyasya dvitIyasaMgrahaH; ‘a(fter) glow’, s. sAyaM-saMDyA-prakASaH. ‘a(fter)-inquiry’, uttarajijYAsA; ‘a(fter)-life’ AyuHSezaH, uttaravayas n.; ‘a(fter) noon’, s. aparAhRaH, parAhRaH, vikAlaH; (a.) aparAhRatana (nI f.), vEkAlika (kI f.); ‘a(fter) pains’, prasavottaravedanA. ‘a(fter) thought’, uttaraciMtA, anuboDaH. ‘a(fter) wards’ paScAt, anaMtaraM, tataH paraM, para.
